name: d0_classical_ring_detector
description: Baseline classical morphological and local-normalized traffic detector for ring cameras.

kernel_sizes.provenance: WP-04 spec v0.1 §1: flat square structuring elements

tile_stride.provenance: WP-04 spec v0.1 §1: 32 px grid spacing for tile centres

mad_scale.provenance: Normal distribution consistency factor for median absolute deviation

sigma_min_clean.derivation: sigma_quant(L) = sigma_s * |dL/ds| where sigma_s = 1/(255*sqrt(12)) for 8-bit uniform quantization. Through sRGB EOTF, dL/ds = 1/12.92 for L <= 0.0031308 and (2.4/1.055)*L^(7/12) for L > 0.0031308, evaluated at each tile's median linear luminance level and bilinearly interpolated.
sigma_min_clean.provenance: WP-04 spec v0.1 §1 and GEMINI_G-B8 A4 (F-B7-5): 8-bit quantization sigma at tile median level through sRGB curve

sigma_min_degraded.provenance: WP-04 spec v0.1 §1: degraded input floor in electrons (below 2.4 e- read noise)

tau_list.provenance: WP-04 spec v0.1 §1 and GEMINI_G-B8 A2: candidate detection thresholds for sweep extended with 12, 15, 20

dilation_kernel_size.provenance: WP-04 spec v0.1 §1: 3x3 structuring element for component grouping
